# Seeker

A stream whose position can be moved.

```rux
pub interface Seeker {
    func Seek(self: &var Self, origin: SeekFrom, offset: int64) -> uint64 ! IoError;
}
```

## Requirements

<h3 id="seek"><code>Seek</code></h3>

```rux
func Seek(self: &var Self, origin: SeekFrom, offset: int64) -> uint64 ! IoError
```

Moves the position `offset` bytes from `origin` and succeeds with where it landed.

| Name     | Type       | Description                            |
| -------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `origin` | `SeekFrom` | where the offset is measured from      |
| `offset` | `int64`    | how far to move, which may be negative |

**Returns**: the resulting offset from the start

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Io/Src/Stream.rux#L59)

## Related

<h3 id="seek-from"><code>SeekFrom</code></h3>

```rux
pub enum SeekFrom: int32 {
    Start = 0,
    Current = 1,
    End = 2
}
```

Where a seek starts counting from.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Io/Src/Stream.rux#L42)

**Cases**

| Name      | Value | Description                                               |
| --------- | ----- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Start`   | `0`   | The start of the stream; the offset must not be negative. |
| `Current` | `1`   | The current position.                                     |
| `End`     | `2`   | The end of the stream.                                    |
